The image shows a leaf with a prominent dark, purple-brown irregular blotch lesion. The affected area has a blotchy, irregular shape with deep purplish-brown coloration on a pale green leaf background.

Analyzing against each class:
- **Berry_Blotch**: Dark, irregular, purplish-brown blotchy lesions on leaf tissue — matches well
- **Brown_Eye_Spot**: Circular spots with a distinct eye-like pattern (lighter center, dark border) — not visible here
- **Cercospora**: Circular spots with gray/tan centers and dark borders — no lighter center visible
- **Miner**: Leaf miner tunneling trails (light serpentine patterns) — not present
- **Phoma**: Pale-centered spots with dark margins — the lesion here lacks a pale center
- **Rust**: Orange/rusty pustules — no orange coloration present

The dark, irregular, purplish-brown blotch without a distinct eye or pale center, covering a broad area of the leaf, is most consistent with Berry_Blotch.
